purpose: One substantive, pre-registered hypothesis on a third non-overlapping BTC/USDT window. Registered before fetching the 2022 window or observing any 2022 result. No grid search, no parameter tuning, no reuse of earlier results to choose parameters.

data.non_overlap: 2022-12-31 < 2024-01-01 (v2) < 2025-11-27 (v1); no shared bar with any prior experiment
data.freshness_rule: Report retrieved_at, dataset_end and age at evaluation. Historical research windows are intentionally old; freshness is recorded as provenance, not used to claim live readiness. If integrity checks fail, STOP.

criteria.note: Identical to all prior registries; no threshold is changed.

cost_assumptions.equivalence: 15 bps per side equals validation-v1's 7.5 fee + 7.5 slippage; spread is now explicit without changing effective cost or criteria

hypothesis.name: Volatility-expansion Donchian breakout with ATR trailing stop and time exit
hypothesis.market_rationale: Daily BTC trend legs often begin with a volatility expansion beyond a prior range. A channel breakout uses high/low and true range rather than close-only moving averages or oscillators, so it is substantively different from exp-01 SMA cross, exp-02 price-above-SMA plus ROC, exp-03 z-score reversion, exp-04 trend-plus-RSI and exp-05 shorter RSI grid. A volatility-scaled trailing stop plus a maximum holding period directly addresses the earlier diagnosis of unstable signals and dead exposure.
indicators: prior N-bar Donchian high from high prices
highest close since entry for trailing stop
hypothesis.entry_rule: At bar i, using only bars up to i-1: enter at bar i open if close[i-1] > max(high[i-lookback:i]) and warm-up is complete.
hypothesis.exit_rule: While long, at bar i use close[i-1]: exit at bar i open if close[i-1] < (highest close since entry - atr_multiple * ATR[i-1]) or bars_held >= max_hold_bars. Inherited 10% stop loss and 30% drawdown kill switch remain active in the engine.
hypothesis.risk_management: ATR-multiple trailing stop, fixed 10% hard stop, 30% portfolio drawdown kill switch, position fraction 1.0, costs on every position change
hypothesis.parameter_origin: Standard channel/ATR conventions chosen a priori before any 2022 data was fetched; NOT derived from exp-01..exp-07 results. Exactly one configuration; NO grid search and NO curve fitting.

execution_procedure: Fetch 365 daily BTCUSDT bars with startTime=1640995200000 and verify integrity/freshness report
Run one fixed configuration through unchanged validation.py (train/validation/OOS + walk-forward)
Generate quant-report.v1 with provenance, costs, metrics and limitations
Run independent verify_report.py and repeat the run to confirm deterministic metrics
Record result as REJECTED or VALIDATION CANDIDATE under unchanged criteria
decision_rule: promote_candidate only if accepted_for_paper_candidate is true AND buy-and-hold comparison is reported honestly. Even then, paper ledger requires separate BOS approval. If rejected, record failure and evidence-based cause; do not relax criteria or re-run with different parameters.
